baseline.note: The frozen beta failed the new contributor-ranking and Shore Up history assertions. Two pre-existing contest assertions also failed in this reduced case grouping. The complete regression group passed on the final build.

focused_engine_checks.reused_evidence: The only changes from beta.1 to beta.2 are launcher metadata and the Shore Up action icon on the Finance card.

ui.method: Interactive English Victoria 3 1.15.1 campaign with seeded state. A temporary panel rendered production localization and UI widgets directly. The checks cover rendered values, not the physical hover path for every tooltip.
observations: Other Goods named three contributors with their percentages, and showed separate boom-loan and total-credit shares.
The Risk header showed coal at -80.00 above iron at -30.00. Smaller hits and zeroes followed.
A charter switch showed 75.0% to 37.5% trust and loss of Railway Mania. The Great Issue showed 8 and 20 months. The recall showed the original balance, request and pool limit.
Recovery showed a 47-day remainder and an expiry date. The Russian-American Company showed distinct dates for Propped Up and Fragile.
Our Last Move showed the Shore Up icon, France, 360 days and the treasury cost.

localization.note: Rendered spot checks used English. Existing localization history supplied 16 previously translated messages per locale.

save_compatibility: Historical recalls, recovery deadlines and company deadlines display the additional detail from the first newly recorded event. Active Great Issues already stored both counters.
